series.title: The Cross — God's Plan of Salvation
series.subtitle: Understanding why Jesus had to die
series.description: A four-lesson Bible study exploring humanity's greatest need, God's perfect plan, and the hope found through Jesus Christ.

introduction.title: The Cross Was Never an Accident
introduction.summary: Many people know Jesus died on a cross, but far fewer understand why His death was necessary. Before the foundation of the world, God had already prepared a way to rescue humanity through Jesus Christ.
content: The cross was not God's backup plan.
It was His plan of redemption from the very beginning.
This study explores why Jesus had to die and what His sacrifice means for every person today.
Each lesson builds upon the previous one, helping you understand not only what happened at Calvary, but how it transforms your life.
introduction.reflection: Before beginning this study, ask yourself: What does the cross truly mean to me?
introduction.prayer: Father, thank You for preparing a way of salvation through Jesus Christ. Open my mind to understand Your truth and soften my heart to respond with faith. In Jesus' name, Amen.

lessons.title: The Problem — Why Sin Matters
lessons.core_truth: Before we understand the cross, we must first understand why the cross became necessary.

questions.question: What is sin?
questions.answer: Sin is choosing our own way instead of God's way.
questions.meaning: Sin breaks our relationship with God.

questions.question: Can good works remove sin?
questions.meaning: Only Christ can provide forgiveness and reconciliation.

lessons.pastoral_care: Many people carry guilt believing they are beyond God's forgiveness. Yet from the beginning, God came searching for Adam and Eve. He still seeks people today with grace and compassion.
lessons.reflection: Where have I been trying to fix what only Christ can restore?
lessons.prayer: Lord, help me honestly recognize my need for You. Thank You for loving me even when I fall short. Amen.

lessons.title: The Promise — God Prepared a Savior
lessons.core_truth: Long before Jesus came to earth, God promised a Savior who would defeat sin and bring hope to humanity.

questions.question: Who is the promised Savior?
questions.meaning: Every prophecy ultimately points to Him.

questions.question: Why is Jesus called the Lamb of God?
questions.answer: Because He became the perfect sacrifice for sin.
questions.meaning: His sacrifice fulfilled God's plan of redemption.

lessons.pastoral_care: Your failures never surprised God. Before you were born, He had already prepared a way for you to experience forgiveness and new life.
lessons.reflection: How does knowing God planned my salvation before I existed change the way I see His love?
lessons.prayer: Thank You, Father, for keeping every promise You have made. Help me trust Your plan even when I cannot see the whole picture. Amen.

lessons.title: The Cross — Justice and Mercy Meet
lessons.core_truth: Jesus willingly took our place so that God's justice could be satisfied and His mercy freely offered.

questions.question: Why was Jesus' death necessary?
questions.answer: He took the punishment our sins deserved.
questions.meaning: Only Christ could provide complete atonement.

questions.question: What did Jesus mean when He said, 'It is finished'?
questions.answer: The work of redemption was complete.
questions.meaning: Nothing needs to be added to Christ's sacrifice.

lessons.pastoral_care: The cross reminds us that sin is serious, but God's love is even greater. No one is beyond the reach of His grace.
lessons.reflection: How does Christ's sacrifice change the way I view God's love for me?
lessons.prayer: Jesus, thank You for willingly taking my place. Help me never treat Your sacrifice lightly, but to live each day in gratitude. Amen.

lessons.title: Living Under Grace
lessons.core_truth: Salvation is God's gift of grace, received through faith, leading to a transformed life in Christ.

questions.question: Can salvation be earned?
questions.meaning: Salvation is God's gift, received by faith.

questions.question: What changes after accepting Christ?
questions.meaning: God begins transforming our lives from the inside out.

lessons.pastoral_care: God did not save you simply to erase your past. He saved you to give you a new future, a new identity, and a living hope that continues every day.
lessons.reflection: What area of my life is God inviting me to surrender as I walk in His grace?
lessons.prayer: Father, thank You for the gift of salvation. Help me live each day in the freedom, joy, and purpose You have given me through Christ. Amen.

course_summary.title: Remember These Four Truths
points: Jesus fulfilled that promise through the cross.
Through faith in Christ we receive forgiveness, new life, and eternal hope.
course_summary.closing_thought: The cross is not simply the center of Christian history—it is the center of God's love story for humanity.
